formations.question: After accounting for the exact judicial-auction, title-transfer, existing-lease and ordinary landlord control surfaces, is there a distinct operator edge beyond acquiring the ownership/lease cashflow asset itself, and does public evidence close the decisive diligence fields?

public_sources.title: Current Jiaxing Nanhu second-auction republication - Mingdian Apartment Office 510
bound_facts: Second auction runs 2026-09-30 through 2026-10-01 at RMB 763,200 for the exact 259.68 sqm office.
Lease runs through 2029-05-15 at RMB 5,000/month.
Although the contract payment cadence was six months, the judicial disposition has switched current collection to monthly.
The current second-auction notice says the buyer may collect rent from the transfer-registration date, with transfer-month rent prorated by remaining days.
The property is stated able to complete transfer registration; buyer must handle registration within 30 days after the court title-confirmation ruling is served.
Property-fee arrears are stated at RMB 17,295 through 2026-12-31 and, under the lease, are borne by the tenant; exact actual arrears remain subject to confirmation.
Land-use termination date remains stated unknown.

public_sources.title: Prior first-auction republication - same Jiaxing asset
bound_facts: The first auction used the earlier wording that the buyer could collect rent from transaction completion.
The current second-auction notice uses the narrower transfer-registration-date receipt start and therefore controls the current research state.
Certificate references are 00404078 and 嘉土国用（2011）第454411号; title originals were not recovered, but the notice states that does not prevent transfer.

public_sources.title: Supreme People's Court network judicial auction rules
bound_facts: Network-auction ownership generally transfers when the auction-completion adjudication is served on the buyer.
This general rule does not override the current auction-specific notice's narrower statement that buyer rent collection starts from transfer registration.

incumbent_control_surfaces.consequence: Price discovery, adjudication and title-transfer mechanics are already owned by the court/platform rail; no separate orchestration edge can be claimed from them.

The non-generic control asset is ownership plus lease succession itself. This is not a generic-agent coordination moat, but incumbent presence does not automatically invalidate the asset-cashflow formation.
Property, utility, tax, deposit and physical-condition work remain diligence/ownership obligations rather than a distinct operator advantage.

exact_public_search_exhaustion.note: Searches resolved to the same auction republications or non-decisive property pages; no suggestive listing was promoted as evidence.

narrowed_facts: Current transfer eligibility is publicly stated as possible rather than wholly unknown.
A registration deadline exists after adjudication service, but the actual adjudication/registration date is not fixed.
The current receipt-start wording is transfer-registration date and supersedes the first-auction transaction-date wording for this research state.
No separate operator moat beyond the acquired ownership/lease right is evidenced; this does not by itself close the formation because incumbent presence is not an automatic rejection.
decisive_unknowns_remaining: Exact tenant identity and current payment quality.
Complete lease, current monthly collection ledger and any prepaid balance.
Actual adjudication and transfer-registration dates, which determine exact future receipt coverage.
Exact buyer-side taxes, fees and normalized net economics.
Land-use termination date and current physical condition.

formations.question: Does the current public record bind a buyer-specific unprepaid rent start early enough to leave at least 24 months through 2029-02-24, or does the decisive chain still terminate at non-public lease and case-specific transfer facts?

public_sources.title: Current Weiyuan first-auction notice republication - Yanling Lanhua Street 46
bound_facts: First auction runs 2026-10-18 through 2026-10-19 at RMB 445,886.28 for the exact 45.08 sqm commercial unit.
The asset is expressly sold with the existing lease from 2022-02-24 through 2029-02-24.
Current rent is RMB 6,000/month, paid quarterly, and rent has been paid through the end of 2026-11.
The notice explicitly says detailed lease content requires telephone consultation.
Execution case is （2026）川1024执1832号 and underlying judgment is （2026）川1024民初929号.

public_sources.title: PRC Civil Code Article 725 - Supreme People's Court republication
bound_facts: Ownership change during the tenant's contractual possession does not affect lease validity.
This establishes generic lease continuity, not the auction-specific accounting of rent already prepaid through 2026-11 or the first rent cycle payable to the buyer.

public_sources.title: Supreme People's Court network judicial auction rules
bound_facts: Auctioned property ownership generally transfers when the auction-completion adjudication is served on the buyer.
The general ownership rule narrows the legal chain but does not publish the case-specific adjudication date or first buyer rent settlement.

causal_chain: Existing lease validity survives ownership change.
Rent through 2026-11 is already paid, so that paid period cannot be assumed to become fresh buyer cash receipt without auction-specific accounting evidence.
The unprepaid contractual tail from 2026-12-01 to 2029-02-24 is about 26.8 months.
To satisfy a full 24-month future-receipt gate, the buyer-specific effective receipt start must be no later than 2027-02-24.
The current public notice does not bind the actual adjudication/transfer date, detailed lease clauses, prepaid-rent allocation or first rent cycle payable to the buyer.
The notice itself routes detailed lease inquiry to telephone consultation, which is an external side effect under current authority.
